form:FormGroup.label: Active Days
form:FormGroup.helpText: The days of the week on which this period applies.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Tick each day this period applies.

form:FormGroup.label: Start Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: The time of day this period starts, in 24-hour HH:mm:ss format, e.g. 08:00:00. Times use the profile's time zone.

form:FormGroup.label: End Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: The time of day this period ends, in 24-hour HH:mm:ss format, e.g. 18:00:00. If it is not later than the start time, the period runs until midnight; it does not continue into the next day.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: 24-hour time, e.g. 18:00:00. Use 00:00:00 to run to midnight.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick to limit how many threads each node can use for processing during this period. When unticked, there is no per-node limit.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, nodes have no thread limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Node Threads
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum number of processing threads each node can use during this period, from 0 to 1,000,000.
Tick to limit the total number of threads the cluster can use for processing during this period. When unticked, there is no cluster limit.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, the cluster has no thread limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Cluster Threads
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum total number of processing threads across the cluster during this period, from 0 to 1,000,000.
